analysis.primaryGoal: Drive immediate sales of summer-themed jewellery packaging at up to 50% off
analysis.audience: Existing and potential B2B customers interested in jewellery packaging and displays
analysis.offer: Up to 50% off selected items, while supplies last

visualStyle.mood: playful and vibrant, summer holiday vibe
visualStyle.imageStyle: 3D product characters with sunglasses and beach accessories set in tropical scenes; product closeups with graphic discount tags

copyStyle.urgency: high (stock warnings, "Når det er væk, er det væk.")

reusablePatterns: Seasonal characters and themed props (e.g., summer items) for emotional appeal
Bold headline with prominent discount percentage
Short, direct copy emphasizing limited stock and urgency
Product images overlaid with large, graphic discount markers
Primary action button in a contrasting color
risks: High urgency and stock warnings may frustrate if products sell out quickly
Heavy theme may feel less relevant outside the summer period
Limited appeal if customer is not in market for discounted items

confidence.notes: Primary text and CTAs are clearly readable; no visible subject line or preheader in screenshot.
